step1_analysis.circuit_type: Injection-Locked Frequency Divider (ILFD) / Regenerative Divider Core
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is the active core of a frequency divider, consisting of a cross-coupled NMOS pair with a tail injection transistor. When loaded with an LC tank, it divides the frequency of an RF signal injected at the tail by 2.

paper_reference.title: A 40-GHz Frequency Divider in 0.18-m CMOS Technology

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the divider circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id ~ 0.5 * uCox * (W/L) * Vov^2. For W=20u, L=0.15u, Vov=0.6V, Id ~ 6.4mA. Power = 1.8V * 6.4mA = 11.5mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper used a 2.5V supply in 180nm. In SKY130 with a 1.8V supply, power consumption will be lower for similar current levels.

output_frequency.description: Frequency of the divided output signal.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_out = f_in / 2. With an injected f_in = 20 GHz, f_out = 10 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: To ensure reliable operation in a simple SKY130 testbench without parasitic extraction, the input frequency is scaled down to 20 GHz, resulting in a 10 GHz output.

division_ratio.description: Ratio of the input injection frequency to the output oscillation frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: This is a fundamental property of this regenerative/injection-locked divider topology.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to verify frequency division by 2 and measure power consumption. An LC tank is added to the outputs to set the free-running frequency near 10 GHz, and a 20 GHz signal is injected at the tail.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Frequency Divider Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Redefine W/L for high-frequency operation in 130nm
.param W_xm1=20u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm3=20u L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm2=20u L_xm2=0.15u

* DUT
XM1 N0 N1 P GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM3 P VIN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2 N1 N0 P GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Inject 20 GHz signal at the tail
VVIN VIN 0 DC 1.0 SIN(1.0 0.5 20G)

* LC Tank tuned to ~10 GHz
L1 VDD N0 1n
L2 VDD N1 1n
C1 N0 N1 0.1p
R1 N0 VDD 1k
R2 N1 VDD 1k

* Initial condition to break symmetry and start oscillation
.ic v(N0)=1.8 v(N1)=0.0

.control
tran 1p 5n

* Measure output frequency (period between 20th and 21st rising zero-crossing)
meas tran t1 trig v(N0) val=1.8 rise=20 targ v(N0) val=1.8 rise=21
let out_freq = 1/t1
print out_freq

* Measure power consumption
meas tran avg_I avg i(VVDD) from=2n to=5n
let power = -avg_I * 1.8
print power

* Calculate division ratio
let div_ratio = 20e9 / out_freq
print div_ratio

quit
.endc
